content: Ek šenafotir biššaš
Toi Isaye manuš okkolore šikka diya šeš gori bade hiba Kofornahum šohorot giyegoi.
Heṛe ekzon Rom šenafotir gulamottu ošuk oi foran zar zar oiye. Ei gulamore he šenafotiye beši ador gorito.
Hite Isar hóbor funi hoekzon Ihudi murobbi mainšore Isar hãse aroz goribolla defeṛaiye zene Isaye zai hitar gulamore aram gori fare.
Hitara Isar hãse zai Isare beša beši aroz gori hodde, "Õne zalla ei ham goriba hite iyan faibar laikka,
kiyolla buli hoile hite ãrar mainšore ador gore edde ãrare sinagog banai diye."

Henot Isa hitarar fũwati giye. Isaye hitar góror hãsa hãsi aišše de hetunot, oi šenafotiye hitar hoekzon fũwajjare hoi defeṛaiyede: "Malik, nizore ar duk no diyo, kiyollahoile õne ãr góror salor tole aiyo, ãi he laikka no.
Ar ãre ãi o õnor hãse aibar laikka mone no gori. Kintu õnor muke ho, henot ãr gulam bala oi zaiboi.

Ãi iyan zani, kiyollahoile ãttu o oinno zonor hokum mozin sola fore, ar ãttu o šena okkol ase. Zodi ãi ekzonore 'Za,' hoi hite za. Ar ekzonore 'Ãi,' hen hoile hite aiye. Ar ãr gulamore 'Iyan gor' hen hoile hite hiyan gore."
Ei hota funi Isaye tajjuf oiye. Ze šob manuš okkol Isar fise fise aišše hitarar uzu firiyore hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare hoir, Israili okkolor butore o eto ḍõr biššaš ãi ar hono šome no deki."

content: Šenafotiye defeṛailde hitara górot firizai sadde he šenafotir gulammuwa aram oi giyegoi.
Ek rari mar lehar fuware zinda goijje
Hotun bade Isa Nain name ek farar mikka za šuru goijje. Hibar fũwati sahabi okkol edde ek ḍõr mainšor dol o giye.

ar hiba ṭon geiṭor hãsa hãsi aišše, toi ar so heṛe ek mora lašore bargori hoborstanot gãraito loizar. He lašwa aššilde ek mar lehar ek fut, he ma aššilde ekzon rari maya fuwa. Ar hibar fũwati šohorottu bout manuš okkol aššil.
Malik Isaye he rarir mayafuwaware deki beši doya laigge edde hibare hodde,

content.text: "No haindis!"

content: Tarfore Isaye hãse zai hãiṭṭagan suiye. Ar hãiṭṭa boi loizaoya okkole tiyaiye. Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "He zuwan fuwa, ãi tore hoir: Uṭ!"

content: Hen šomot he mora lašwa uṛi boišše edde hite hota howa šuru goijje. Toi Isaye hitare hitar mar hatot tulidiye.
Hetunot beggunor dilot Allar ḍor góille edde Allar tarif gori howa šuru goijje. "Ãrar maze ekzon moha nobi uiṭṭe, ar Allaye hibar bonda okkolor uzu mon diye!"
Bade šara Ehudiya edde hiyanor sairo mikkar elehat Isar hanḍor babute sorai giyegoi.
Isar hãse Yahyar šagirit okkol
Yahyar šagirit okkole ei šob goṭona beggun Yahyare funaiye. Ar Yahyaye duizon šagiritore ḍaikke,
edde hitarare Malik Isar hãse fusar goitto defeṛaiye, "Ze aibar hota, he zon ki õne, naki ãra oinno zonolla entezarot takiyum?"
Toi hitara Isar hãse zaiyore hodde, "Torikotor gusol doya Yahyaye ãrare õnor hãse defeṛaiye, 'Ze aibar hota he zon ki õne, naki ãra oinno zonor entezarot takiyum?'"
He šomot Isaye bout manuš okkolore biyaram, hošto edde bod ruh, in okkolottu hitarare aram goijje. Hibaye aro bout anda mainšor sukore bala gori diye.
Isaye Yahyar šagirit dunizonore endilla zuwab diye,

content.text: "Tũwara zo, zin deikko edde fuinno he hóbor Yahyare hogoi: Andaye deker, lenge aṛer, kurus biyaraimma pak saf or, nafange funer, mora uṛi zargoi, edde gorib okkololla bala hóbor tobolig gora or.
Ar mubarok hite, ze ãr zoriya ujaṭ hái fori no zagoi"

content: Yahyar hoborguwa okkol zaigoi bade, hibaye manuš okkolore Yahyar babute howa šuru goijje:

content.text: "Tũwara bošoti sara elehat ki saito gilade? Boyare lorede hóir ne?
No oile, ki saito gilade? Šundor hor findda ekzon manušore ne? So, dami hor finde edde zak zomok loi zibon haṛa, hitara mehelot take.
Toile ki saito gilade? Ki ekzon nobi re? Oi, ãi tũwarare hoir, ekzon nobittuwaro beši!
Iba oilde hiba zar babute kitabot leka ase:
"'Sa, ãi tor age ãr hóborguware defeṛair,
hite tor age zai tolla fõt saf goribo.'
Ãi tũwarare hoir, narittu zormo oiyede hitarar maze, Yahyattuwaro mohan kiye nai; tarfore o Allar raijjot ze šobsaite beši šoṛo, hite o hibattuwaro mohan."

content: (Ar šomosto manuš okkol edde hazna adaigoroya okkole ei hota funi Allah niyaiban hoi kobul goijje, kiyollahoile hitara Yahyar hãsottu torikotor gusol loiye,
kintu Foroši edde dórmiyo alem okkole Yahyar hãsottu torikotor gusol no lowat hitara nizor šommonde Allar eredare befol goijje.)

content.text: "Henoile ei zobanar manuš okkolore ãi har loi tulona goijjum? Hitara honḍoilla?
Hitara en fuwaindor ḍoilla zara bazarot boi ekzone ar ekzonore ḍakiyore hodde:
"'Ãra tũwaralla baši bazailam,
kintu tũwara no nasila.
Ãra dukkor gan gailam,
kintu tũwara no handila.'
Kiyollahoile torikotor gusoldoya Yahya aišše, edde hite ruṭi ba ãnguror roš no har, ar tũwara hor, 'Hitare bute faiye.'
Ar Adomor Fut ai há fiya gorer buli tũwara hor: 'So, ei manušwa hánar lalsi bonda edde šorafkur, ar hazna adaigoroya mainšor bondu.'
Kintu Allar giyanor butore ze za hitar zibone forman gore ze Allar giyan soiyi."

content: Ek gunagar mayafuwar guna maf gori diye
Ekzon forošiye hitar górot Isare hánar dawat diye. Hetunot Isa he forošir górot giye edde hána haito boišše.
Ehon, he šohorot ek gunagar maya fuwa aššil. Hibaye Isa he forošir górot hána hadde zani fariyore ek dola fattoror boyomot gori kušbo tel loi hiba heṛe aišše.

Bade hibaye Isar fis ḍakottu ṭengor hãse zai tiyaiye edde hainde. Tarfore sukor fani loi, Isar ṭengor fata bizai diye edde hibar matar sul loi hin fũsi loiye. Tarfore hibaye Isar ṭengor fatat suma diye edde kušbo tel maki diye.
Toi ze forošiye Isare dawat dil hite ei abosta deki mone mone hodde, "Ei manušwa zodi nobi oito toile zani farito, iba hon ḍoilla maya fuwaye suwer, kiyollahoile hiba ekzon gunagar maya fuwa."
Hetunot Isaye he forošire hodde,

content.text: "Simon, ãttu tore kissu hoibar ase."

content: Hite hodde, "Ustad, ho na."

content.text: "Ekzon ṭĩya udar doyattu duizon mainše hozzo loiye. Ekzone hozzo loiye fãs šot ṭĩya, ar ekzone fõnzaš ṭĩya.
Kintu hitarar he hozzo fuzibar ra no takone, ṭĩya udar doyaye hitara dunizonor hozzogun maf gori diye. Ehon, itarar butore hone he ṭĩya udar doyare beši muhabbot goribo?"

content: Simone hodde, "Zar beši hozzo maf oiye, hite boli mone gori ãi." Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tui ṭik hoiyos."

content: Toi Isaye he mayafuwawar uzu firiyore Simonore hodde,

content.text: "Ei mayafuwaware dehor ne? Ãi tor górot golilam, tui ãre ṭeng dúibolla fani no dos, kintu ibaye sukor fani di ãr ṭeng bizaiye edde nizor sul loi hin fũsi loiye.
Tui ãre suma di solam no goros, kintu zehon loti ãi butore aišši, hibaye ãr ṭengor fatat suma diyat roiye.
Tui tel di ãr matat maki no dos, kintu hibaye kušbo tel ãr ṭengot maki diye.
Hetolla ãi tore hoir, Hibaye beši guna gorile o hibar guna maf gora oiye, ar etolla hibaye beši muhabbot dehaiye. Kintu zare olfo maf gora za, hite olfo muhabbot deha."

content: Bade Isaye he mayafuware hodde,

content.text: "Tor guna maf gora oiye."

content: Zara Isar fũwati hána haito boiššil hitara hitara howa hoi gora šuru goijje, "Iba honnuwa ze guna udda maf gori de?"
Isaye hetunot he mayafuwaware hodde,

content.text: "Tor imane tore uddar goijje, šanti gori zagoi."
